parsed.title: Bonus Save Slot
parsed.oneLiner: Watch a quick game to expand your article library.

newMechanic.name: Library Capacity Limit
newMechanic.description: Limit free account article saving to 50 slots. Existing saved articles remain fully accessible; new saves are blocked until expansion or subscription.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Creates a scarce resource anchor for rewarded ads, distinguishing free from premium tiers.

parsed.trigger: User opens the sidebar menu, where capacity is displayed.

offer.title: Expand Your Library
offer.body: Library full (50/50). Play a game for +5 slots, or see premium plans.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: The reward is a partial, additive expansion for non-payers. Subscription plans remain clearly superior (unlimited storage).

kpis.holdout: 10% user holdout for 4 weeks to measure capacity usage and revenue impact.

risks: Frustration risk from capping previously unlimited storage; mitigated by clearly stating existing content is safe.
Low utilization if users do not save many articles; mitigated by capacity usage monitoring.

newElements.change: Add storage status indicator (e.g., 45/50 slots) with 'Upgrade' link and 'Play for Slots' CTA button.

storyboard.caption: AOL sidebar today, providing general account navigation.

callouts.text: New capacity tracker: 50/50 used. Upgrade or Play to unlock.

storyboard.caption: Introduce a 50-article save limit, protecting existing content.
When user hits the 50-slot limit, the expansion offer appears.
User plays the interactive rewarded mini-game.
Library capacity is updated immediately upon successful ad completion.
